title: PC2: Politically Controversial Content Generation via Jailbreaking Attacks on GPT-based Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Translating adversarial text-to-image prompts into 72 different languages and measuring the attack success rate (ASR) to demonstrate the discrepancy in safety filter robustness between high-resource languages (e.g., English) and low-resource languages.

Calculating geopolitical sensitivity scores using Wikipedia-based historical and sociopolitical data to evaluate how the perceived toxicity or political sensitivity of entities varies depending on the regional and linguistic context.
